offering_description.value: Provides infrastructure services to utilities and telecom operators, including engineering, construction, maintenance and upgrades of natural gas, electric and fiber networks. Work is performed under contracts with utility customers, using crews and specialized equipment.

primary_services.value: gas pipeline installation and replacement; electric utility line work; telecom fiber network construction; engineering and locating services; maintenance and emergency response

customer_segment.value: B2B: gas and electric utilities, telecommunications network operators

revenue_model.value: service fees: payments for construction, maintenance and engineering work on utility networks; project or contract: master service agreements and unit-price contracts with utility customers

value_chain_position.value: service provider: outsourced utility and telecom infrastructure work, sold to utilities and telecom operators

geography_served.value: US national: operates across much of the United States through several regional operating areas

specialization.value: related lines: gas, electric and telecom infrastructure services sold to utility customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with utility and telecom customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: work on regulated gas and electric systems under pipeline safety and OSHA worker safety rules

notes: Customer mix and service scope are based on general knowledge and may have changed.
